title: userloginendpointauthentication
description: Verify that the user login endpoint correctly authenticates users with valid credentials and returns a JWT token, and rejects invalid credentials with appropriate error messages.

title: userregistrationendpointvalidation
description: Test the user registration endpoint to ensure it successfully registers new users with valid data and handles duplicate or invalid input gracefully.

title: otpverificationendpointfunctionality
description: Validate the OTP verification endpoint to confirm it correctly verifies one-time passwords for multi-factor authentication and handles expired or incorrect OTPs properly.

title: getnotaryprofileendpointretrieval
description: Check that the get notary profile endpoint returns accurate and complete notary profile information for authenticated users.

title: updatenotaryprofileendpointupdate
description: Test the update notary profile endpoint to ensure it correctly updates notary profile details and validates input data.

title: assignnotarytojobendpointassignment
description: Verify that the assign notary to job endpoint assigns a notary to a job correctly, respecting business rules and role permissions.

title: uploaddocumentendpointupload
description: Test the document upload endpoint to ensure documents are uploaded successfully, stored securely, and metadata is correctly recorded.

title: signdocumentdigitallyendpointprocessing
description: Validate the digital signature endpoint to confirm it processes digital signatures correctly and updates document status accordingly.

title: createjobendpointcreation
description: Verify that the create job endpoint allows authorized users to create new jobs with valid data and returns appropriate success responses.

title: processpaymentendpointprocessing
description: Test the process payment endpoint to ensure payments are processed correctly through Stripe integration, including handling of payment failures and success confirmations.
